testcase.name: Scenario: Inspect and navigate sketch dependencies: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:493:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect and navigate sketch dependencies ✔ Given a part in the MCAD Software contains a rectangular sketch on the XY plane used by one extrusion ✔ And the sketch references the center point ✔ When the user chooses Relationships from the sketch row context menu ✔ Then the Relationships dialog identifies the sketch as the selected item ✔ And its Parents list contains the XY plane and center point ✔ And its Children list contains the extrusion ✔ When the user selects the XY plane in the Parents list ✔ Then the XY plane row is highlighted in the model browser ✔ And the plane is highlighted in the viewport ✔ When the user selects the extrusion in the Children list ✔ Then the extrusion row and its solid edges are highlighted ✔ When the user activates the navigation control beside the extrusion ✔ Then the dialog identifies the extrusion as the selected item ✔ And its Parents list contains the XY plane and the sketch ✔ And its Children list is empty ✔ When the user activates the navigation control beside the sketch in the Parents list ✔ Then the dialog identifies the sketch as the selected item again ✔ And its Children list contains the extrusion ✔ When the user clicks Done ✔ Then the Relationships dialog closes
